def set_plain_inline(c, text):

def set_rich_inline(c, text, matches, normal_rpr, red_rpr):

def rpr_from_font(font_el, force_red=False):
    """Convert a workbook font element to a rich-text rPr element."""
    rpr = ET.Element(q("rPr"))
    has_color = False

    if font_el is not None:
        for child in list(font_el):
            local = child.tag.split("}", 1)[-1]
            if local == "name":
                new_child = ET.Element(q("rFont"), child.attrib)
            elif local == "color":
                has_color = True
                new_child = ET.Element(q("color"), {"rgb": "FFFF0000"} if force_red else child.attrib)
            else:
                new_child = ET.Element(q(local), child.attrib)
            rpr.append(new_child)
